title: 국립박물관 소장유물 대여 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 8 (Liability for Compensation)
(1) Where a person borrowing a museum-held artifact loses it, that person shall compensate for an equivalent amount as requested by the museum director.
(2) Where a person borrowing a museum-held artifact damages it, that person shall repair and restore it as requested by the museum director and compensate for an amount equivalent to any reduction in its value caused by the damage.
(3) A person borrowing museum-held artifacts shall obtain insurance to cover the repair or restoration measures or the amounts of compensation under paragraphs (1) and (2).
